title: Receiving & Putaway

purpose.en: The list of pallets waiting in a receiving or QC hold area. Open a pallet to see the suggested bin, scan the pallet and then the bin, and the stock moves through a real Stock Transfer.
purpose.id: Daftar palet yang menunggu di area penerimaan atau karantina QC. Buka palet untuk melihat bin usulan, pindai palet lalu bin, dan stok pindah lewat Stock Transfer yang asli.

keywords: putaway, receiving, penerimaan, taruh barang, simpan ke rak, usulan bin, suggested bin, dock to line, urgent, tugas gudang, warehouse task, scan palet, pindai, sampling

steps.en: Open the screen. A task is made by itself for every pallet that is still in a Receiving or QC Hold area.
steps.id: Buka layar. Tugas dibuat sendiri untuk setiap palet yang masih ada di area Receiving atau QC Hold.

steps.en: Use the boxes on top as filters: All today, Waiting sampling, Ready to put away, URGENT to line and Done.
steps.id: Pakai kotak di atas sebagai saringan: All today, Waiting sampling, Ready to put away, URGENT to line, dan Done.

steps.en: A pallet whose batch is Waiting sampling cannot be put away yet. When the quality decision is made the task becomes ready.
steps.id: Palet yang batch-nya Waiting sampling belum bisa disimpan. Setelah keputusan mutu dibuat, tugasnya menjadi siap.

steps.en: Open a ready row. The suggested bins are listed with the reason. Scan the pallet label, then scan the bin label.
steps.id: Buka baris yang siap. Bin usulan tampil beserta alasannya. Pindai label palet, lalu pindai label bin.

steps.en: If the bin is not the first suggestion, fill in the Reason. Then click Confirm; the stock moves and the Stock Transfer number is kept.
steps.id: Bila bin bukan usulan pertama, isi Reason. Lalu klik Confirm; stok pindah dan nomor Stock Transfer tersimpan.

steps.en: A Conditional (URGENT) batch shows Send to line: scan the pallet and the bin of the production floor or staging area instead of a storage bin.
steps.id: Batch Conditional (URGENT) tampil Send to line: pindai palet dan bin di lantai produksi atau area staging, bukan bin penyimpanan.

fields.label: Pallet
fields.en: The pallet number printed on the pallet label.
fields.id: Nomor palet yang tercetak di label palet.

fields.label: Receipt
fields.en: The receipt document the pallet came with.

fields.label: Item
fields.en: The item name and code on the pallet.
fields.id: Nama dan kode item di palet.

fields.label: Batch
fields.en: The batch number of the pallet. Stock without a batch counts as released.
fields.id: Nomor batch palet. Stok tanpa batch dianggap released.

fields.label: Qty
fields.en: The quantity on the pallet, in the unit shown next to it.
fields.id: Jumlah di palet, dalam satuan di sebelahnya.

fields.label: Arrived
fields.en: When the pallet label was made at the receiving area.
fields.id: Waktu label palet dibuat di area penerimaan.

fields.label: Quality
fields.en: The quality status of the batch: Waiting sampling, Released, Conditional (URGENT), Rejected or Blocked.
fields.id: Status mutu batch: Waiting sampling, Released, Conditional (URGENT), Rejected, atau Blocked.

fields.label: Suggested Bin
fields.en: The bin chosen by the area rules, with the reason below it. The officer decides by scanning.
fields.id: Bin pilihan aturan area, dengan alasan di bawahnya. Petugas memutuskan lewat pindai.

fields.label: Action
fields.en: Putaway when ready, Send to line for a Conditional batch, Waiting QC, Not available or Done.
fields.id: Putaway bila siap, Send to line untuk batch Conditional, Waiting QC, Not available, atau Done.

fields.label: Scan pallet
fields.en: Scan or type the pallet number. It must be the pallet of the task.
fields.id: Pindai atau ketik nomor palet. Harus palet milik tugas itu.

fields.label: Scan bin
fields.en: Scan or type the bin code. A blocked bin, a bin locked for counting or a bin that breaks the Mixing rule is refused.
fields.id: Pindai atau ketik kode bin. Bin yang diblokir, dikunci untuk hitung, atau melanggar aturan Mixing ditolak.

fields.label: Reason
fields.en: Required when the scanned bin is not the first suggestion. It is kept on the task.
fields.id: Wajib bila bin yang dipindai bukan usulan pertama. Tersimpan di tugas.

title: Area Rules and Virtual Locations

purpose.en: How the rules of a storage area (Mixing, Pick Order, Count Every) and the virtual areas (At Subcontractor, In Transit, Loss) work.
purpose.id: Cara kerja aturan area penyimpanan (Mixing, Pick Order, Count Every) dan area virtual (At Subcontractor, In Transit, Loss).

keywords: area rules, aturan area, mixing, one item per bin, one batch per bin, pick order, fifo, fefo, count every, virtual, subkon, in transit, loss, lokasi virtual, storage areas

steps.en: In Storage Areas choose Mixing: Mixed items, One item per bin, or One batch per bin. Putaway and Stock Transfer refuse a bin that would break the rule.
steps.id: Di Storage Areas pilih Mixing: Mixed items, One item per bin, atau One batch per bin. Putaway dan Stock Transfer menolak bin yang melanggar aturan itu.

steps.en: Pick Order tells whether the oldest received (FIFO) or the earliest expiry (FEFO) is taken first from the area. Count Every is the number of days between counts.
steps.id: Pick Order menentukan yang diambil lebih dulu dari area: yang paling lama diterima (FIFO) atau yang kedaluwarsanya paling awal (FEFO). Count Every adalah jumlah hari antar hitung.

steps.en: At Subcontractor, In Transit and Loss are virtual areas: stock is in the books but not on the floor. They are not on the Warehouse Map and have no Generate Bins.
steps.id: At Subcontractor, In Transit, dan Loss adalah area virtual: stok ada di buku tetapi tidak di lantai. Tidak tampil di Warehouse Map dan tidak punya Generate Bins.

steps.en: Virtual bins are made by the system when needed: one bin for Loss, one for In Transit and one per subcontractor supplier. You do not type them.
steps.id: Bin virtual dibuat sistem saat dibutuhkan: satu bin untuk Loss, satu untuk In Transit, dan satu per supplier subkon. Tidak perlu diketik.

fields.label: Mixing
fields.en: Mixed items, One item per bin, or One batch per bin.
fields.id: Mixed items, One item per bin, atau One batch per bin.

fields.label: Pick Order
fields.en: FIFO (oldest received first) or FEFO (earliest expiry first).
fields.id: FIFO (paling lama diterima dulu) atau FEFO (kedaluwarsa paling awal dulu).

fields.label: Count Every (days)
fields.en: Days between two counts of the area. Leave empty when the area has no count schedule.
fields.id: Jumlah hari antara dua kali hitung area. Kosongkan bila area tidak punya jadwal hitung.

fields.label: Virtual
fields.en: Filled by the system from the Use of the area. It cannot be typed.
fields.id: Diisi sistem dari Use area. Tidak bisa diketik.
